5efe3008-7a80-4e41-9fc2-35289c2985e3.text:
(Junior) AI Engineer AI工程師 — 優必達台灣有限公司

Ubitus is a global leader in AI and cloud solutions and an NVIDIA Connect member, delivering industry-leading GPU virtualization and cloud streaming platforms — spanning AI model deployment and training, AI robotics, and cross-platform cloud gaming, all running on large-scale hybrid-cloud GPU infrastructure.
Backed by a JPY 17 billion METI grant to build a top-tier AI GPU center in Japan, we are scaling fast. We're looking for a driven engineer with a "can-do" and "eager-to-learn" mindset to grow with our Innovative and Security Team.

Our Innovative and Security Team builds the offline, on-premise AI solutions that power enterprise AI transformation — products companies can run securely inside their own environments. Our current focus:
•	Coding agents and cowork-style copilots that boost developer and knowledge-worker productivity
•	Fine-tuned, domain-specialized models tailored to each customer's data and workflows
•	AI-powered cybersecurity defense — using AI to strengthen threat detection and protection
•	Other frontier, innovative AI application products
We work with cutting-edge technology — Agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, SkyPilot, PyTorch, and Kubernetes — and modern Agile and DevOps practices. If you're eager to master AI, cloud infrastructure, and system security, we'd love to grow with you.

What You'll Do
•	Help build on-premise / offline AI solution products — from prototype to production — with guidance from senior engineers.
•	Contribute to coding agents and cowork-style copilots: integrate tools, build agent skills, improve real-world usefulness.
•	Support fine-tuning of domain-specialized models — data prep, training, evaluation, and iteration.
•	Explore AI for cybersecurity defense and other innovative application ideas.
•	Build and deploy AI services on GPU infrastructure using PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker.
•	Write clean, tested code and follow Agile and DevOps practices (CI/CD, Git, code review).

Requirements
•	0–3 years of software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of AI/ML projects (new grads with solid fundamentals are welcome).
•	Solid programming skills in Python.
•	Foundational understanding of machine learning and LLMs (how they work, prompting, fine-tuning, RAG basics).
•	Hands-on experience with PyTorch or a similar ML framework (coursework, personal projects, or internships count).
•	Familiarity with Git and a willingness to learn cloud, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices.
•	Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a real eagerness to learn.
•	Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a team; basic English proficiency.

Nice to Have
•	Experience building AI agents or with agent frameworks (Pi (pi.dev), OpenCode, Hermes Agent, MCP).
•	Experience fine-tuning LLMs or working with domain-specific datasets.
•	Interest or background in cybersecurity / defensive security.
•	Exposure to on-premise / offline model deployment, quantization, or inference optimization (vLLM, etc.).
•	Cloud experience (AWS / GCP / Azure), Docker, or Kubernetes.
•	Open-source contributions or a public portfolio (GitHub, Kaggle, blog).

Why Join Us
•	Work on real, enterprise-grade on-premise AI products at a world-leading AI and cloud company.
•	Learn from senior engineers building coding agents, fine-tuned models, and AI security solutions.
•	Access to large-scale GPU infrastructure, backed by major national investment.
•	A supportive, fast-moving team that values learning and ownership — an ideal place to level up your AI career.

經驗：3年以上
學歷：專科

questions.text: What interests you about building on-premise/offline AI products, and how would you decide when a prototype is ready to move toward production?
questions.meaningZh: 你對建置本地端／離線 AI 產品有什麼興趣？你會如何判斷原型何時已準備好進入生產階段？
questions.rationale: This assesses motivation for the core product setting and practical judgment about moving from prototype to production.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能評估你對核心產品環境的動機，以及將原型推進到生產階段的實務判斷力。
questions.evidence: Help build on-premise / offline AI solution products — from prototype to production — with guidance from senior engineers.

questions.text: Please describe a Python AI or automation project you have worked on and one design choice you made; if you have not worked on one, how would you structure a small Python service for an AI feature?
questions.meaningZh: 請描述一個你做過的 Python AI 或自動化專案，以及你做出的一項設計選擇；如果你尚未做過這類專案，你會如何為一項 AI 功能規劃一個小型 Python 服務？
questions.rationale: This checks Python fundamentals and concrete design reasoning without presupposing prior project experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能檢視 Python 基礎與具體的設計推理能力，同時不預設你已有專案經驗。

questions.text: How would you explain the difference between prompting, fine-tuning, and RAG, and when might you choose each?
questions.meaningZh: 你會如何解釋提示工程、微調與 RAG 之間的差異？你可能會在什麼時候選擇各自的方法？
questions.rationale: This checks foundational understanding of three LLM application approaches and the ability to choose among them.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能檢視你對三種 LLM 應用方法的基礎理解，以及在其中做出選擇的能力。
questions.evidence: Foundational understanding of machine learning and LLMs (how they work, prompting, fine-tuning, RAG basics).

questions.text: Suppose a PyTorch model has good training accuracy but poor validation performance. How would you investigate the problem and decide what to try next?
questions.meaningZh: 假設一個 PyTorch 模型的訓練準確率良好，但驗證表現不佳，你會如何調查問題並決定下一步嘗試什麼？
questions.rationale: This evaluates practical ML debugging, hypothesis formation, and experiment planning with a PyTorch model.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能評估你使用 PyTorch 模型進行實務機器學習除錯、形成假設與規劃實驗的能力。
questions.evidence: Hands-on experience with PyTorch or a similar ML framework (coursework, personal projects, or internships count).

questions.text: If you were adding a tool to a coding agent or cowork-style copilot, how would you define the tool interface, control permissions, and evaluate whether it improves usefulness?
questions.meaningZh: 如果你要為 coding agent 或協作型 copilot 新增工具，你會如何定義工具介面、控管權限，並評估它是否提升實用性？
questions.rationale: This explores agent-building judgment, safe tool integration, and evaluation of real-world usefulness.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能探討你在建置 agent、以安全方式整合工具，以及評估實際實用性方面的判斷力。
questions.evidence: Experience building AI agents or with agent frameworks (Pi (pi.dev), OpenCode, Hermes Agent, MCP).

questions.text: Describe a fine-tuning or domain-dataset project you have done, or, if you have not done one, how would you prepare data, train a model, evaluate it, and iterate?
questions.meaningZh: 請描述一個你做過的微調或領域資料集專案；或者，如果你尚未做過，你會如何準備資料、訓練模型、評估模型並反覆改進？
questions.rationale: This assesses understanding of the end-to-end fine-tuning workflow while providing a fair alternative for candidates without direct experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能評估你對端到端微調流程的理解，同時為沒有直接經驗的候選人提供公平的替代方式。
questions.evidence: Experience fine-tuning LLMs or working with domain-specific datasets.

questions.text: Design a high-level deployment plan for an AI service on GPU infrastructure using Docker and Kubernetes. What would you monitor, and how would you handle limited GPU capacity?
questions.meaningZh: 請設計一個使用 Docker 與 Kubernetes、將 AI 服務部署到 GPU 基礎設施上的高層次方案。你會監控什麼？又會如何處理有限的 GPU 容量？
questions.rationale: This tests deployment thinking, container and orchestration concepts, and awareness of GPU-resource trade-offs.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能測試你的部署思維、容器與編排概念，以及對 GPU 資源取捨的認識。
questions.evidence: Build and deploy AI services on GPU infrastructure using PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker.

questions.text: How would you use Git, code review, tests, and CI/CD to keep a small AI service reliable while the team iterates quickly?
questions.meaningZh: 在團隊快速反覆開發時，你會如何運用 Git、程式碼審查、測試與 CI/CD，讓小型 AI 服務維持可靠？
questions.rationale: This checks practical understanding of quality and delivery practices for an evolving AI service.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能檢視你對不斷演進的 AI 服務所需品質與交付實務的理解。
questions.evidence: Write clean, tested code and follow Agile and DevOps practices (CI/CD, Git, code review).

questions.text: Tell me about a difficult technical problem you solved and how you learned what to do; if you have not faced one in a work setting, how would you approach an unfamiliar AI problem?
questions.meaningZh: 請告訴我一個你解決過的困難技術問題，以及你如何學會該採取什麼做法；如果你尚未在工作情境中遇過這種問題，你會如何處理一個不熟悉的 AI 問題？
questions.rationale: This evaluates problem-solving process, curiosity, and learning behavior without assuming prior employment experience.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能評估你的問題解決流程、好奇心與學習行為，同時不假設你已有工作經驗。
questions.evidence: Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a real eagerness to learn.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you explained a technical issue or handled a disagreement with teammates; if you have not encountered this, how would you communicate and collaborate in that situation?
questions.meaningZh: 請告訴我一次你向隊友解釋技術問題或處理意見分歧的經驗；如果你尚未遇過這種情況，你會如何在該情境中溝通與合作？
questions.rationale: This assesses communication and collaboration in a team while allowing a hypothetical response when past experience is unavailable.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能評估你在團隊中的溝通與合作能力，並在缺乏過往經驗時允許以假設情境回答。
questions.evidence: Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a team; basic English proficiency.

questions.text: What AI-powered cybersecurity defense problem would you be interested in exploring, and what risks would you consider before proposing a solution?
questions.meaningZh: 你有興趣探索哪一個 AI 驅動的網路安全防禦問題？在提出解決方案前，你會考量哪些風險？
questions.rationale: This assesses interest in defensive security and the ability to consider risks before designing an AI application.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能評估你對防禦性安全的興趣，以及在設計 AI 應用前考量風險的能力。
questions.evidence: Interest or background in cybersecurity / defensive security.

questions.text: In two or three English sentences, explain a technical AI concept to a non-specialist, then describe how you would check that they understood.
questions.meaningZh: 請用兩到三句英文向非專業人士解釋一個 AI 技術概念，然後描述你會如何確認對方理解了內容。
questions.rationale: This checks basic English proficiency and the ability to communicate technical ideas clearly.
questions.rationaleZh: 這能檢視基本英文能力，以及清楚溝通技術概念的能力。
questions.evidence: Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a team; basic English proficiency.

question.meaningZh: 請用一到兩分鐘介紹自己：你的背景、和這個職位相關的經驗，以及為什麼想應徵。
question.rationale: Practise a concise introduction that connects your background and relevant experience to this role. This is a common practice question, not a question from the employer.
question.rationaleZh: 練習簡潔地介紹背景，連結與職位相關的經驗和應徵動機。這是常見練習題，不是雇主提供的題目。

attempts.transcript: I am a backend engineer based in Taipei, with about three years at a medium-sized e-commerce company. I mainly use Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Redis, and I have used some Node.js. Alongside my usual work, I built an internal RAG FAQ bot with LangChain and pgvector. I checked its answers manually against a spreadsheet of 50 questions, and I have also used OpenAI function calling. This role interests me because it combines backend engineering with practical AI products. I have not fine-tuned a model or used Kubernetes, and my Docker experience is basic. I would bring my backend and RAG experience while learning those areas with guidance from senior engineers.

relevance.quote: This role interests me because it combines backend engineering with practical AI products.
relevance.reason: Clearly connects your backend background, RAG project, and motivation to the role.
relevance.reasonZh: 清楚連結你的後端背景、RAG 專案，以及你對這個職位的動機。

support.reasonZh: 提供了實際參與 RAG 工作的具體證據，但沒有說明機器人的成果或影響。

structure.reason: The introduction moves logically from background and skills to a relevant project, motivation, and development areas.
structure.reasonZh: 內容依序從背景與技能，進入相關專案、應徵動機，以及待發展領域，邏輯清楚。

englishExpression.quote: I would bring my backend and RAG experience while learning those areas with guidance from senior engineers.
englishExpression.reason: Uses clear, natural, and professional English with appropriately concise sentences.
englishExpression.reasonZh: 英文清楚、自然且專業，句子簡潔得當。

strength.text: You give a concise, role-relevant introduction that connects your backend experience, a concrete RAG project, and your motivation.
strength.textZh: 你提供了簡潔且切合職位的自我介紹，連結了後端經驗、具體的 RAG 專案，以及應徵動機。

priorityImprovement.textZh: 如果有相關資訊，請補充 RAG 機器人的用途與可觀察成果，並讓應徵動機更具體地對應這個職位；目前專案影響與職位契合度仍較概括。
priorityImprovement.quote: This role interests me because it combines backend engineering with practical AI products.

88e911ee-047a-4d19-98cc-05a904118e0f.focusPoint: 下次自介說清楚內部 RAG FAQ 的用途及 50 題人工核對方式，並具體連結這個職位的企業 AI 應用；不補造未有的成果或部署經驗。
